# Actual CSS

> Plain CSS component framework for new projects: semantic classes, shared variants, small tokens, theme hooks, and progressive enhancement.

Actual CSS uses a small public grammar: `.component [intent] [variant] [size] [modifier]`. It claims unprefixed class names by design. Existing projects with collisions should use cascade layers, import order, or an application-side prefix transform.

## Documentation

- [Docs index](docs/README.md): the maintained map of user docs and design notes.

## Package Entrypoints

- CSS: `actual-css`, `actual-css/css`, `actual-css/css/layer`, `actual-css/css/components`, `actual-css/css/forms`.
- Optional CSS: `actual-css/css/optional/typography-fluid`, `actual-css/css/optional/scroller`.
- JavaScript: `actual-css/js`, plus individual enhancers such as `actual-css/js/dialog`, `actual-css/js/flyout`, `actual-css/js/tooltip`, `actual-css/js/tab`, `actual-css/js/inputmode`, and `actual-css/js/mask`.
